edit_summary: Commit f9cd92ae closes the whole class rather than the cited instances. Round 2's Critical was found independently by BOTH reviewers: AC-049/TEST-049's 'every one of those renames is rolled back' includes resolver-evidence.yaml, which four other sites require that Block to write. Root cause, stated once: this package says 'every rename' / 'every target' / 'no artifact' / 'no earlier-staged artifact' in many places where it means the three publication artifacts, and resolver-evidence.yaml is the one member of every transaction target set that must SURVIVE, because AC-012 excepts two diagnostic ids and none of these. REQ-001 step (m) now carries a single normative rollback-and-no-write scope rule: the subject of every such statement is facet-manifest.yaml / capability-summary.yaml / generated/project-context.resolved.json, never resolver-evidence.yaml, which instead carries that Block's own record written directly AFTER any rollback completes - rolling Evidence back would destroy the only record that the rolled-back publication was attempted. Every other site now POINTS AT that rule instead of restating it. Sixteen sites from a whitespace-normalised sweep across all seven documents: requirements.md (REQ-001 step (m), REQ-002's post-publication-generation-mismatch row, AC-038, AC-039, AC-049, Field Definitions 'Block', the Edge Cases post-recheck bullet); acceptance-tests.md (TEST-038, TEST-039, TEST-049); design.md (Post-publication verification, in-process rollback, MIX recovery, the AC-039 and AC-049 acceptance mirrors, the AC-038 Design Decisions mirror); security-spec.md (TEST-038/039/049 rows); infra-spec.md (MIX rollback); tasks.md (T-005's transaction summary and its AC-038/AC-039/AC-049 Done-When bullets, with Status, Approval, headings, Scope table and risk tier untouched). Reviewer A's two Majors are closed in the same commit: the on-disk-area invariant is restated as being about the Evidence write's own ROUTE rather than the area's existence, because the two step-14 Blocks reach an Evidence-only write set only after the transaction created that area; and both REQ-001 step (m) and REQ-004 now state the Evidence-only condition as a PREDICATE ('any Block at which no publication artifact is left standing') instead of the step list (0)/(a)/(h)/(i)/(k)/(l)/(m), which omitted at least seven Evidence-only Blocks including the ruling-C(1) and C(2) sites. No AC or TEST id added, renumbered or removed; the enum stays closed at sixteen; no exception added to REQ-002. Commit d0f2f0a records the remediation in investigation.md with per-document SHA-256 for all six changed documents.
